title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Standardization of Handling Civil Retrial Procuratorial Recommendation Cases
keywords_en: Handling of cases involving procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Circular on Issuing the Opinions on Regulating the Handling of Cases Involving Procuratorial Suggestions for Civil Retrial

Fa Fa [2023] No. 18

The Higher People's Courts and the People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army and the Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region and the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

To standardize the procedures of the people's courts and the people's procuratorates in handling cases involving procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial, to promote the implementation of the Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Strengthening the Legal Supervision of Procuratorial Organs in the New Era, to enhance the quality and effectiveness of legal supervision and judicial credibility, and to promote judicial fairness, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate have formulated the Opinions on Regulating the Handling of Cases Involving Procuratorial Suggestions for Civil Retrial, which are hereby issued for your implementation in light of actual circumstances. Any problems encountered during implementation shall be reported step by step to the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

November 24, 2023

Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Opinions on Regulating the Handling of Cases Involving Procuratorial Suggestions for Civil Retrial

To standardize the procedures of the people's courts and the people's procuratorates in handling cases involving procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial, to promote the implementation of the Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Strengthening the Legal Supervision of Procuratorial Organs in the New Era, to enhance the quality and effectiveness of legal supervision and judicial credibility, and to promote judicial fairness, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and other legal provisions, and in light of judicial practice.

Article 1. Procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial are an important means for the people's procuratorates to exercise legal supervision over effective civil judgments, rulings, and mediation documents. The people's courts and the people's procuratorates shall strictly comply with the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China concerning procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial, and shall lawfully and normatively perform their duties of trial and legal supervision. The people's procuratorates shall adhere to the supervision standard combining legality and necessity, enhance the timeliness and effectiveness of supervision, and normatively apply procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial; the people's courts shall insist on accepting supervision in accordance with the law, enhance the initiative and consciousness in accepting supervision, and promptly handle cases involving procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial, jointly safeguarding judicial fairness.

Article 2. Where a people's procuratorate discovers that an effective civil judgment or ruling of a people's court at the same level falls under any of the circumstances specified in Article 207 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, or that a civil mediation document damages the national interest or the social public interest, it may issue a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial to the people's court at the same level; where a local people's procuratorate at any level issues a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial, it shall file a report with the people's procuratorate at a higher level for the record.

Where a people's procuratorate discovers that an effective civil judgment, ruling, or mediation document was obtained by a party to the civil litigation through false litigation, it shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of Article 18 of the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Further Strengthening the Work on Punishing False Litigation Crimes.

Article 3. A people's procuratorate generally shall not exercise supervision by way of issuing a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial over an effective civil judgment, ruling, or mediation document rendered by a people's court at the same level after retrial or discussion by the judicial committee.

Clerical errors or expression defects existing in effective civil judgments, rulings, or mediation documents of the people's court shall not constitute circumstances for issuing a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial; the people's procuratorate may propose suggestions for improvement.

Article 4. A people's procuratorate shall generally decide to issue a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial after discussion by the procuratorial committee. Under special circumstances, the people's procuratorate may consult with the people's court at the same level for a resolution.

Article 5. Where a people's procuratorate issues a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial, it shall transfer the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial together with the procuratorial case materials to the people's court at the same level.

The procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial shall state the relevant circumstances of the case, the supervision opinion, and shall list the circumstances under which the original judgment, ruling, or mediation document falls within the provisions of Articles 215 and 216 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Where a case in which a people's procuratorate issues a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial does not comply with the preceding provisions, the people's court shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of Article 414 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 6. The people's court shall, within seven days from the date of receipt of the qualified procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial and related procuratorial case materials, assign a case number, incorporate the case into the case flow management, conduct a review in accordance with the law, and notify the people's procuratorate.

The fact that the court itself or a higher-level people's court has already rendered a ruling dismissing an application for retrial shall not affect the people's court's acceptance of the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial issued by the people's procuratorate at the same level.

Where a case for which a people's procuratorate has issued a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial has already been ruled by the people's court at the same level to be retried but has not yet been concluded, the people's court shall incorporate the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial into the retrial case and try it together, and shall inform the people's procuratorate by letter. Where the case has been ruled by a higher-level people's court to be retried but has not yet been concluded, the people's court at the same level may submit the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial and the procuratorial case materials to the higher-level people's court and inform the people's procuratorate that issued the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial.

Article 7. The people's court shall form a collegial panel to review a case involving a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial and shall complete the review within three months. Where there are special circumstances requiring an extension, the review period shall be extended in accordance with the relevant approval procedures.

Adjudicators who participated in the trial of the case in the original trial proceedings shall not participate in the handling of the case involving the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial.

Article 8. The people's court shall generally conduct a written review of a case involving a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial by examining the case materials transferred by the people's procuratorate and reviewing the case files of the original trial. Where, upon review, the case may initiate a retrial or there are other circumstances where it is truly necessary, the parties concerned shall be questioned.

Article 9. Where, upon review of a case involving a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial, the people's court considers that the original judgment, ruling, or mediation document is indeed erroneous and decides to adopt the procuratorial suggestion to initiate a retrial, the retrial ruling shall state the supervisory organ and the document number of the procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial. The ruling shall be served on the people's procuratorate at the same level.

Where the people's court decides, upon review, not to initiate a retrial, it shall reply in writing to the people's procuratorate and state the reasons. The people's procuratorate may, in an appropriate manner, inform the applicant of the result that the people's court will not initiate a retrial.

Article 10. A civil case in which the people's court adopts a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial to initiate a retrial shall be tried in court in accordance with the procedures provided for in subparagraphs (3) and (4) of paragraph 1 of Article 402 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. Where any of the following circumstances exists, the people's procuratorate may send personnel to appear in court:

(1) The people's procuratorate considers that the handling of the original case damages the national interest or the social public interest;
(2) The people's procuratorate considers that there is false litigation in the original case;
(3) Evidence investigated and verified by the people's procuratorate needs to be presented to the court;
(4) There are other circumstances where appearance in court is truly necessary, such as those having significant social impact.

Where the people's procuratorate sends personnel to appear in court, the trial in court may be conducted by reference to the procedures provided for in subparagraph (2) of paragraph 1 of Article 402 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 11. For a civil case in which the people's court adopts a procuratorial suggestion for civil retrial to initiate a retrial, the judgment or ruling rendered after the retrial shall be served on the people's procuratorate at the same level. Where the case is concluded by mediation, the people's court shall notify the people's procuratorate at the same level in writing.

Article 12. The people's court and the people's procuratorate shall establish a mechanism for joint mediation of cases involving procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial, and shall properly carry out mediation and conflict resolution work for such cases.

Article 13. The people's court and the people's procuratorate shall explore the establishment of normalized working communication mechanisms. For cases involving group disputes or those that have attracted widespread social attention and may affect social stability, as well as major, difficult, complex, sensitive, and other cases, the people's court and the people's procuratorate shall strengthen mutual communication during the handling process and shall handle them properly in accordance with the law.

Article 14. The people's court and the people's procuratorate shall regularly conduct comprehensive analyses and notifications regarding the work of procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial, promote positive interaction between trial supervision and procuratorial supervision, and enhance the quality and effectiveness of handling cases involving procuratorial suggestions for civil retrial.

Where local people's courts and people's procuratorates at all levels encounter new situations or new problems in practice, they may first consult with each other and shall timely report the relevant issues and countermeasures step by step to the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate.
